ratings.reviewer_notes: Directly shows that brief low-dose BMP2 preconditioning promotes hMSC osteogenic differentiation and activates SMAD1/5/8 signaling.
Tests a magnesium aluminate composite scaffold with BMP2 in human BMSCs and reports enhanced osteogenesis with activation of BMP2/SMAD and other osteogenic pathways.
Directly identifies Gremlin2 as a negative regulator of BMP2-induced hBMSC osteogenesis through the BMP2/Smad/Runx2 pathway.
Directly demonstrates that benzo[a]pyrene inhibits BMP2-induced MSC osteogenesis through AhR-dependent reduction of BMPRII and impaired Smad1/5/8 signaling.
Shows that Toxoplasma gondii excretory proteins promote hBMSC osteogenic differentiation by activating BMP2, Smad1, and phosphorylated Smad1/5.
Review-level context on ATF4 in osteoblast differentiation; BMP2/Smad is described mainly as an upstream pathway involved in ATF4-mediated differentiation.
Directly identifies miR-21 as a promoter of BMMSC osteogenesis involving the Smad7-Smad1/5/8-Runx2 signaling axis.
Directly shows KR-12-a6 promotes hBMSC osteogenic differentiation through BMP/SMAD signaling, supported by pathway inhibition with LDN-212854.
Demonstrates that Juglans regia leaf extract promotes hBMSC osteogenesis through BMP2/Smad/Runx2 and Wnt/beta-catenin pathways; Noggin reverses the effect.
Review of Runx2-driven BMMSC osteogenesis that includes BMP among numerous interacting signaling mechanisms, but does not focus specifically on BMP-dependent regulators.
Directly reports that liraglutide enhances osteogenesis of human alveolar BMSCs, including cells from diabetic patients, through BMP2/Smad/Runx2 signaling.
Identifies miR-494 as an inhibitor of BMP2-induced osteogenesis by directly targeting BMPR2 and RUNX2 under simulated microgravity.
Directly shows that space microgravity suppresses hMSC osteogenic differentiation partly by decreasing BMP2 expression and SMAD1/5/9 activity.
Directly identifies RUNX1 as a modulator of BMP9-induced osteogenic differentiation in a mesenchymal stem cell line and related murine multilineage cells.
Shows that elevated BMP2 and overactivation of Smad1/5/8 cause enhanced osteogenic differentiation of MSCs from patients with OPLL.
Directly establishes miR-765 as an inhibitor of hMSC osteogenic differentiation by targeting BMP6 and reducing Smad1/5/9 signaling.
Directly demonstrates that PDGF-AA promotes MSC osteogenic differentiation by downregulating PDGFRalpha and derepressing BMPR-dependent Smad1/5/8 signaling.
Shows beta-catenin synergizes with BMP2 to promote osteogenic differentiation of multipotent mesenchymal cells and new bone formation.
Reports that a mineralized lotus-stalk scaffold containing MnCO microspheres promotes MSC differentiation through activation of BMP2/SMAD/RUNX2 signaling.
Directly tests BMP2 overexpression in rat BMSCs and shows enhanced osteogenic differentiation with increased nuclear Runx2 and phosphorylated Smad1/5/8.
Identifies piRNA-36741 as a promoter of BMSC osteogenesis by preventing METTL3-mediated m6A modification of BMP2 transcripts, increasing BMP2 and Smad activity.
Shows that combined suppression of Noggin and miR-138 promotes MSC osteogenesis, increases BMP2 expression, and activates Smad1/5 and ERK signaling.
